summary: Audit found 7 issues (2 high, 3 medium, 2 low). The primary finding: Proposition.subformulas/IsSubformula are duplicated between Normalization.lean and SubformulaProperty.lean (135 lines copy-paste with lk- prefix renaming), caused by a phantom Tableau.Defs import in CutElimination.lean that creates a Proposition.complexity name collision. Proposition.complexity is also duplicated (Tableau/Defs.lean line 110 vs Normalization.lean line 149, identical definitions). Fix: create shared Subformula.lean module, remove phantom import, update 3 consumer files. No other cross-module duplication found in the 77-file subtree. Additional medium issues: Normalization.lean at 1143 lines, generic Finset helpers misplaced in CutElimination.lean, mixed concerns in Tableau/Defs.lean. Low issues: barrel import inconsistency, sorry inventory (13 active sorries across 5 tableau/normalization files).
